infoCompanyBusinessSummary.title: Business Summary
infoCompanyBusinessSummary.body: Cable Solutions operates in the cable manufacturing industry, exporting to 13 countries and contributing to 94% of its total revenue. Cable Solutions offers a range of engineering solutions in the form of standard cables, customized cables, cable harnesses and connectors. Their market reach spans across major economies including USA, Spain, India, Sweden & Austria.
